onlyIntervention: Existing whole Persona JSON vs absent. Same goal/UI/initial state/profile per task. No trait-specific routes/rules.
order: Replicate blocks; tasks sessions/preferences/privacy; actor order offset=(replicate-1+taskIndex)%4. Partial counterbalance, not randomized.
stop: Immediate source/input/persona/replay/audit/accounting/safety/provider/auth/quota. Isolated model-invalid/timeout preserve invalid and continue. Two consecutive invalid stop. No replacements.
primary: Observed task choices/path/help/details/review/revisits and within/between actor distances per task. Valid capped trajectories included up to bound, explicitly censored. Invalid prefixes separate; no outcome-based path exclusion.
secondary: Reason category self-reports; candidate visual target identity separately from generated annotation text. Same pixels do not mean identical full inputs.
interpretation: Descriptive 3repeats, no calibrated significance/human fidelity or individual Persona field attribution. Smartphone not simulated.
